source_row.stem: A hospital's shared governance model includes unit-based practice councils. These councils typically:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Allow staff nurses to participate directly in decisions related to practice standards, quality, and unit-level issues","B":"Generally considered to carry little real decision-making authority over unit-level practice issues","C":"Intended for use only within non-clinical departments, rather than direct patient care units","D":"Led exclusively by hospital executives rather than by the staff nurses working on the unit itself"}}
source_row.rationale: Unit-based practice councils within a shared governance model allow staff nurses to participate directly in decisions related to practice standards, quality initiatives, and unit-level issues, promoting engagement and ownership.
